source.publication: 2025 Nebraska Individual Income Tax and Amended Return Booklet (8-307-2025), with 2025 Form 1040N and Schedule I
source.section: Form 1040N PDF pages 1-2, lines 2a, 4a, 4b, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 34, 35; booklet PDF page 12 lines 2a, 4a, 4b; PDF page 13 line 5, line 6 and the Nebraska Standard Deduction Chart; PDF page 14 lines 10 to 18; PDF page 17 lines 34, 35 and the Federal Tax Liability Worksheet; PDF pages 46-49 Tax Table and over-77,760 worksheet (schedule as numbers, as settled in the record from the table); settlement log question 1 and 3: no Schedule I line (lines 14 to 43, booklet PDF pages 24-28) takes this income out, so it stays in federal AGI on line 5; projection capital_gains is empty; Form 4797N's special deduction is not in the sources

worked: Single, 50: wages 80,000 and long-term gains 20,000. Gains are ordinary income for Nebraska: no special rate and no general subtraction (the special election on Schedule I line 19 needs Form 4797N, which is not in the sources). Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 80,000.00 + long-term gains 20,000.00 = 100,000.00. Federal taxable income = 100,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 84,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 1040N filing status (1) single, resident. Line 2a: 0 box(es) checked (no one born before January 2, 1961). Line 4a 1; line 4c none; line 4 total 1. Line 5 federal AGI 100,000.00. Line 6 Nebraska standard deduction, chart for 0 box(es): 8,600.00; lines 7 to 9 skipped (no federal itemizing); line 10 8,600.00. Line 11 = 100,000.00 - 8,600.00 = 91,400.00. Line 12 adjustments increasing federal AGI 0.00. Line 13 adjustments decreasing federal AGI 0.00. Line 14 Nebraska taxable income = 91,400.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 91,400.00. State income after additions and subtractions (before the deduction) = 100,000.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 100,000.00. Line 15 tax, schedule as numbers (single column): 2.46% x 4,030.00 = 99.138 + 3.51% x 20,090.00 = 705.159 + 5.01% x 14,750.00 = 738.975 + 5.20% x 52,530.00 = 2,731.560; total 4,274.832, rounded once to 4,274.83. The page 49 worksheet gives (taxable income - 77,760) x .0520 + 3,566 = 13,640.00 x .0520 + 3,566 = 4,275.28; expected keeps the schedule. Line 16 0.00 (no lump-sum or early-distribution tax); line 17 = 4,274.83. Line 18 personal exemption credit = 171 x 1 = 171.00; line 34 171.00. Line 35 = 4,274.83 - 171.00 = 4,103.83. Federal Tax Liability Worksheet (PDF page 17): net adjustments 0.00 are under 5,000, but it does not reduce line 35: the federal tax before credits on the part other than long-term gains is at least 10% x 64,250.00 = 6,425.00, above worksheet line 2 of 4,103.83.
accepted_approximations: The brackets are fitted to the printed tax table; no rate schedule is in the sources. The start of the 5.20% band is not pinned by the table: single and married filing separately 38,793 to 38,897, head of household 57,535 to 57,639, married filing jointly 77,501 to 77,760. The table's rows also round to the dollar at the row's midpoint, and the bands do neither.
